name: liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass
description: A web approximation of Apple's Liquid Glass: a surface that refracts what sits behind it through a curved rim, splits colour at the edge, and catches a light that orbits toward the pointer. Chromium gets true refraction through an SVG displacement filter in `backdrop-filter`; other browsers get frosted glass; `prefers-reduced-transparency` gets an opaque surface.
